summary: Mergeable PR that fixes a long-standing issue with HttpResponse handling memoryview objects.

issues.description: The patch adds a memoryview type check, but it's not the most Pythonic way to do it. A more idiomatic check would be to use the isinstance() function with the collections.abc.ByteString abstract base class.
The patch uses a comment to explain the reasoning behind the change, but it would be better to add a docstring to the make_bytes() method to explain its behavior and the types it supports.
